name: CFX MoveUSD
oneLiner: MOVEUSD is CFX's Solana bank-deposit dollar token backed 1:1 by USD deposits in beneficiary accounts at FDIC-insured banks.
collateral: U.S. dollar deposits held 1:1 in beneficiary accounts at participating FDIC-insured banks for approved CFX customers.
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption route for approved CFX customers, with MOVEUSD intended to settle one-to-one against bank deposits rather than a Treasury reserve portfolio.

applicabilityBasis.summary: MOVEUSD is a CFX-issued dollar token for payment and settlement flows, redeemable through designated channels for approved customers.

genius.licensingRegulator: FinCEN / state money transmitter regulators; Metropolitan Capital Bank & Trust banking partner context
genius.notes: MOVEUSD public materials describe CFX issuance and designated redemption channels, but Pharos found no public GENIUS issuer intent, PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source. CFX's July 30 2025 press release describes MOVEUSD as 'GENIUS-ready' (first on Ethereum and Base), framing this as architectural alignment with reserve and redemption requirements — this is marketing language, not a formal PPSI pathway announcement, and does not meet the bar for issuer-announced-intent. The original reserveDisclosureUrl (docs.moveusd.com/docs/disclosures-disclaimers) now redirects to docs.cfx.to with no dedicated reserve disclosure page found; reserveDisclosurePresent updated to false accordingly.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS issuer intent, token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for MOVEUSD. CFX's 'GENIUS-ready' marketing claim describes architectural alignment, not a regulatory pathway.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: MoveUSD is issuer-managed on Solana and public docs describe a centralized CFX issuance and redemption process; available registry sources do not prove a holder-level freeze path.

reserves.name: USD deposits in beneficiary accounts at FDIC-insured banks

notices.title: Tokenized-deposit profile
notices.message: MoveUSD is tracked because DefiLlama reports a current price and circulating supply, but its public materials present it as a CFX-issued stable token for approved customers rather than an open DeFi-native stablecoin.

mintAuthority.summary: On-chain read at Solana slot 425778537 shows the MOVEUSD SPL mint authority is set to the mint address itself (self-referential). A non-executable SPL mint account cannot sign transactions, so no party can currently exercise the mint authority. The freeze authority is also self-referential. This is a chain-state data fix: the previous issuer-backend model does not match on-chain reality; new minting is effectively frozen at this address.

controls.label: MOVEUSD SPL mint authority (self-referential / effectively burned)
controls.evidence: At Solana slot 425778537, getAccountInfo for mint 3AdhVEX6k85yNivHVXDEiY3WyP2WgFQTUZCahGaeC2qm (standard SPL-Token, owner TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA) returned mintAuthority: 3AdhVEX6k85yNivHVXDEiY3WyP2WgFQTUZCahGaeC2qm and freezeAuthority: 3AdhVEX6k85yNivHVXDEiY3WyP2WgFQTUZCahGaeC2qm — both set to the mint account itself. The mint account is not executable and owned by the Token program; it cannot sign transactions. No signer can invoke MintTo. Supply is fixed at 120,020,117.706406 MOVEUSD.

review.evidence: At Solana slot 425778537, MOVEUSD SPL mint 3AdhVEX6k85yNivHVXDEiY3WyP2WgFQTUZCahGaeC2qm has self-referential mint and freeze authority. Recent transactions (slot 425778219) are token transfers, not mints. Supply is static. Chain-state data fix: mintPath remains issuer-direct-mint reflecting original issuance model, but directMintAbility updated to none — no further minting is possible via this SPL mint.
